original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚高原州士兵解救三名被绑架女性
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚高原州博科斯地方政府区马孔当村三名年轻女性于周三夜间遭枪手绑架，居民在获救后表达欣慰与宽慰。"持久和平行动"部队在马孔当村与绑匪对峙后，将三名受害者安全解救。行动发言人、上尉波利卡普·奥特在乔斯向记者证实了这一情况。

location.site: Makundang village, Mangor District, Bokkos Local Government Area
location.raw_text: Makundang village in Mangor District, Bokkos Local Government Area of Plateau State

key_facts.fact: 三名年轻女性在高原州博科斯地方政府区马孔当村遭枪手绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Residents of Makundang village in Mangor District, Bokkos Local Government Area of Plateau State, have expressed joy and relief following the rescue of three young women abducted by gunmen on Wednesday night.

key_facts.fact: "持久和平行动"部队与绑匪对峙后安全解救三名受害者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Troops of Operation Enduring Peace (OPEP) rescued the victims unharmed after confronting their abductors in Makundang village.

key_facts.fact: 三名受害者分别为19岁的Fatigi Aguna、18岁的Lovina Bawa和18岁的Barsheba Appolos
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The victims were identified as Miss Fatigi Aguna, 19; Lovina Bawa, 18; and Barsheba Appolos, 18.

key_facts.fact: 行动发言人奥特上尉在乔斯向记者证实此次行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Confirming the development to journalists in Jos on Saturday, the spokesperson for Operation Enduring Peace, Captain Polycarp Oteh, said the operation was part of ongoing efforts by security personnel to protect lives and property across the Joint Operations Area.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
绑匪身份及后续处置情况未获确认
